Fresh trailing result follows the readable snapshot
200 coalesced requests total only two reads
Each read posts a single UI completion

Hidden request burst performs no extra read
Resume reads fresh metadata

Old lifecycle result does not paint after resume

Current lifetime result survives old generation
Pause clears the trailing request
Close is terminal and idempotent
Close discards a pending UI completion
Read error never calls UI from worker
Read failure is delivered once on main executor
Read can recover after a failure

scope: Complete production EnvironmentRefreshQueue compiled and executed with manually advanced worker/main Executor queues and explicit read/delivery adapters. Counts queued reads and applied snapshots under bursts, lifecycle epochs, close, callback reentrancy and failures. No Android frame, SQLite, disk, network or wall-clock performance measurement.
